title: Validate the inputs of add
brief: add() accepts any value. Make it throw a TypeError when either argument is not a finite number, with a message that names the argument, and add a test for it.

title: Add a subtract function
brief: Add subtract(a, b) to lib/calc.mjs with the same validation as add, export it, list it in README.md, and test it.

title: Document the library
brief: README.md should say how to install and run the tests, and show how to use every exported function with one example each.
